summary: Red-phase tests-only run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Committed: (1) OpenAPIContractTests.swift - 10 permanent unit tests pinning the vendored OpenAPI document (JSON, 3.0.x, at iOS/Sources/ColorMatchingOpenAPI/OpenAPI/openapi.json), Package.swift wiring (swift-openapi-generator plugin + OpenAPIRuntime), all six app surfaces with methods/success statuses/operationIds, bearer auth, and the exact schema shapes the app's wire format requires; verified red at head by direct inspection (vendored spec path absent; Package.swift contains none of the required references). (2) APIClientSurfaceTests.swift - green wire-parity keepers (stubbed URLProtocol, no live server) covering manifest decode, recent sheets with null title, and 401 propagation, which must remain green when APIClient is rewired onto the generated client. (3) docs/ios-openapi-client-plan.md - pinned decisions, the full prose-contract vs published-spec delta table (manifest and ranked-results under-declared by upstream spec; measurement upload missing stats/scoring_algorithm_version; uploads now return JSON bodies; capture_id is integer-as-string; patch ids are '<pair>#<side>'), required vendoring patches, and the AC-to-verification map. Execution note: no Swift toolchain exists in this container and the ColorMatchingLPSApp executable target imports iOS-only frameworks, so swift test could not run locally; tests are desk-checked and execute on the macOS CI runner (.github/workflows/ci.yml runs swift test). Implementation ACs are intentionally red at this tests-only head; the separate implementation run turns them green.
